full_page.content:
Pg. 30. Handwritten notes of Retreat at St. Bonaventure's 1943, October 10 - 15. Fr. Martin, O.F.M.Cap.
Conferences
Monday.
I. Faith .... flaming into charity
II. Mary our Bl. Mother's Solicitude - - The Sailor's wife of Norway, burning her house to light him and son home in storm: Little boy in Passion Play: "why don't he turn to Mary?" Telegram "Are you alri't
III. Men of God, by example, not by oratory or by making monkies of them- selves - worldliness - draw souls to God and salvation.
Tuesday
I. Worth - Privilege - of daly, "common place duties in religion - to the Monastery - province - Order - Church - redemption.
II. Divine Office .... rather than writing books, lectures, sermons etc. - Devoutly.
III. Death. "Learn from Brother Death. Why fear death?
Wednesday
I. Obedience .. various Kinds - und Obedience the Franciscan.
II. Sacrifice of life that life remain. annual tragedy of Alonquin Indians - to send a choice maiden over the Niagara Falls. ... . Jesus .... the Host our Sacrifice.
III. Vow of Chastity ....
Thursday
I. Mortification - Physical - mental - Let it be temperat .. - in order.
II. Confidence ... in God. ... to be fostered at all times .... St. Peter ... had fostered it in his many mistakes. Juds has not made open mistakes.
III. Patience - - Calumny - - Suspicion - - Whispering. ... In your patience .... possess your Soul.
